FunctionExpressionBody:ErrorHandler.kt:ErrorHandler${ return when { // Errors that already carry a typed domain code. Localized copy // from the producer wins; transport failures get the shared copy // for their code (their raw text is a Ktor message with the // request URL, not something to show); otherwise the message is // raw data-layer text: missing -> the caller's default, blank -> // the category's recovery suggestion. exception is DomainException -> errorFromCode( code = exception.code, message = exception.displayMessage ?: transportMessage(exception.code) ?: exception.message.let { if (it == null) defaultMessage else rawMessage(it) }, recoveryAction = recoveryAction, originalException = exception ) // Timeout errors exception is TimeoutCancellationException || exception is HttpRequestTimeoutException || exception is ConnectTimeoutException || exception is SocketTimeoutException -> UserFriendlyError( title = MR.strings.error_title_timeout.desc(), message = MR.strings.error_message_timeout.desc(), category = ErrorCategory.NETWORK, recoveryAction = recoveryAction, originalException = exception, errorCode = ErrorCode.TIMEOUT ) // HTTP 4xx — authorization, missing resources, other client errors exception is ClientRequestException -> { val status = exception.response.status.value val code = when (status) { 401 -> ErrorCode.UNAUTHORIZED 403 -> ErrorCode.FORBIDDEN 404 -> ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND else -> ErrorCode.CLIENT_ERROR } val message = when (status) { 401, 403 -> MR.strings.error_message_forbidden.desc() 404 -> MR.strings.error_message_not_found.desc() 429 -> MR.strings.error_message_too_many_requests.desc() else -> defaultMessage } errorFromCode(code, message, recoveryAction, exception) } // HTTP 5xx exception is ServerResponseException -> UserFriendlyError( title = MR.strings.error_title_server.desc(), message = MR.strings.error_message_server.desc(), category = ErrorCategory.SERVER, recoveryAction = recoveryAction, originalException = exception, errorCode = ErrorCode.SERVER_ERROR ) // Connectivity failures below the HTTP layer exception is IOException -> UserFriendlyError( title = MR.strings.error_title_network.desc(), message = MR.strings.error_message_network.desc(), category = ErrorCategory.NETWORK, recoveryAction = recoveryAction, originalException = exception, errorCode = ErrorCode.NETWORK ) // Malformed payloads exception is SerializationException -> UserFriendlyError( title = MR.strings.error_title_data.desc(), message = MR.strings.error_message_invalid_payload.desc(), category = ErrorCategory.DATA, recoveryAction = recoveryAction, originalException = exception, errorCode = ErrorCode.INVALID_DATA ) // Authentication errors // Note: SecurityException is JVM-specific, so we check by exception message instead (exception.message?.contains("security", ignoreCase = true) == true || exception.message?.contains("permission", ignoreCase = true) == true) -> UserFriendlyError( title = MR.strings.error_title_authentication.desc(), message = MR.strings.error_message_authentication.desc(), category = ErrorCategory.AUTHENTICATION, recoveryAction = recoveryAction, originalException = exception, errorCode = ErrorCode.UNAUTHORIZED ) // Data errors exception is IllegalArgumentException || exception is IllegalStateException -> UserFriendlyError( title = MR.strings.error_title_data.desc(), message = exception.message?.let { StringDesc.Raw(it) } ?: MR.strings.error_message_invalid_data.desc(), category = ErrorCategory.DATA, recoveryAction = recoveryAction, originalException = exception, errorCode = ErrorCode.INVALID_DATA ) // Default for unknown errors — repositories attach a typed // ErrorCode at the boundary (AR-2), so anything reaching here has // no better classification available: no message-substring // guessing (locale/format-fragile, SH-12), just a generic error. else -> UserFriendlyError( title = getCategoryTitle(ErrorCategory.UNKNOWN), message = defaultMessage, category = ErrorCategory.UNKNOWN, recoveryAction = recoveryAction, originalException = exception, errorCode = ErrorCode.UNKNOWN ) } }
